claim: For the characteristic-three reduction of the integral Igusa-quartic equation, the projective Jacobian singular scheme has a length-\(6\) embedded component at \(P=(1:\cdots:1)\), the common vertex of the \(15\) pair-partition lines.
integrity_notes: Exact finite-field checks are reproducible with verify_char3_igusa.py and requirements.txt.
No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Determines the support and length of the embedded Jacobian excess, not its full local Artin algebra.
Concerns the displayed integral equation reduced modulo 3; no modular interpretation of the special fibre is asserted.
The full text of the original 1962 paper was not obtained.
title: The characteristic-three Jacobian defect of the Igusa quartic
